name: adv_gnn_sage_clean
title: Mini-batch GraphSAGE and heterogeneous link prediction, correct
note: The correct twin: one NeighborLoader per split, only the training loader shuffling, seed nodes taken from the split's own mask, model selection on val_mask and test_mask touched exactly once at the end under eval mode and no_grad; negatives drawn against the training edge index only and BCEWithLogitsLoss fed raw scores. It carries no `expected` row and must carry no finding. MLView measures 55 nodes / 58 edges, reports zero findings, and declares three coverage gaps - two `unresolved_callee` rows naming torch_geometric and one `untagged_dataflow` row naming MLV305 - which is the honest answer for a project built on a library it has no knowledge table for.
